1: // Minimal Neon Maze game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
8: 
9:   // player state
10:   const player = {
11:     x: W / 2,
12:     y: H - 60,
13:     size: 15,
14:     speed: 2,
15:     dir: 0, // radians, 0 = up
16:     color: '#0ff'
17:   };
18: 
19:   const walls = [];
20:   const orbs = [];
21:   let score = 0;
22:   let gameOver = false;
23: 
24:   // generate a wall segment ahead of player
25:   function genSegment(yPos) {
26:     const gap = 120; // gap width for player to pass
27:     const left = Math.random() * (W - gap - 40) + 20;
28:     const right = left + gap;
29:     walls.push({ x: 0, y: yPos, w: left, h: 20 }); // left wall
30:     walls.push({ x: right, y: yPos, w: W - right, h: 20 }); // right wall
31:     // possibly place an orb in the gap
32:     if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
33:       const ox = left + gap / 2;
34:       orbs.push({ x: ox, y: yPos + 10, r: 6, collected: false });
35:     }
36:   }
37: 
38:   // initial maze
39:   for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) genSegment(i * 40);
40: 
41:   // controls
42:   document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
43:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') player.dir -= Math.PI / 2;
44:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') player.dir += Math.PI / 2;
45:   });
46: 
47:   function update() {
48:     if (gameOver) return;
49:     // move forward
50:     player.x += Math.sin(player.dir) * player.speed;
51:     player.y -= Math.cos(player.dir) * player.speed;
52: 
53:     // keep inside canvas horizontally (wrap)
54:     if (player.x < 0) player.x = W;
55:     if (player.x > W) player.x = 0;
56: 
57:     // generate new segment as we scroll up
58:     const minY = Math.min(...walls.map(w => w.y));
59:     if (player.y - minY < H) genSegment(minY - 40);
60: 
61:     // collision with walls
62:     for (const w of walls) {
63:       if (
64:         player.x + player.size > w.x &&
65:         player.x - player.size < w.x + w.w &&
66:         player.y + player.size > w.y &&
67:         player.y - player.size < w.y + w.h
68:       ) {
69:         gameOver = true;
70:       }
71:     }
72: 
73:     // collect orbs
74:     for (const o of orbs) {
75:       if (!o.collected && Math.hypot(player.x - o.x, player.y - o.y) < player.size + o.r) {
76:         o.collected = true;
77:         score++;
78:       }
79:     }
80:   }
81: 
82:   function draw() {
83:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
84:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
85: 
86:     // draw walls
87:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
88:     for (const w of walls) {
89:       ctx.fillRect(w.x, w.y, w.w, w.h);
90:     }
91: 
92:     // draw orbs
93:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
94:     for (const o of orbs) {
95:       if (!o.collected) {
96:         ctx.beginPath();
97:         ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
98:         ctx.fill();
99:       }
100:     }
101: 
102:     // draw player
103:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
104:     ctx.fillRect(player.x - player.size, player.y - player.size, player.size * 2, player.size * 2);
105: 
106:     // UI
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
108:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
109:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
110:     if (gameOver) {
111:       ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2 - 50, H / 2);
112:     }
113:   }
114: 
115:   function loop() {
116:     update();
117:     draw();
118:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
119:   }
120:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
121: })();
